summary: The current v45 queue labels the first extra RNG calls as the nhlib.lua shuffle, but the missing source owner is quest.c:finish_quest. The admitted Wizard case throws the Eye of the Aethiopica into peaceful, mobile quest leader Neferet; dothrow.c:thitmonst calls finish_quest(obj), whose offeredit pager initializes Lua and emits the two draws. The same source function also runs when quest.c:chat_with_leader finishes a #chat or passive leader conversation. The accepted iron-ball delivery freed the previously overlapping dothrow.js path, so both production caller paths are available for this task.

source.branch: When a peaceful quest leader is able to move after catching a thrown quest artifact, and the hero has not already completed the quest or obtained the Amulet, finish_quest(obj) selects offeredit/offeredit2, displays the quest completion pager, sets got_thanks and qcompleted, identifies the returned artifact, and updates inventory. If the hero has the Amulet, it uses hasamulet instead; non-quest unique items follow their own identify/verbalize branches.
callers: dothrow.c:thitmonst (line 2138) calls finish_quest(obj) after a peaceful, mobile quest leader catches a thrown quest artifact.

quest.c:chat_with_leader (lines 297 and 311) calls finish_quest(NULL) with the Amulet or finish_quest(otmp) when the hero carries the quest artifact; quest_chat and leader_speaks/quest_talk reach this caller.
dependencies: questpgr.c:qt_pager/com_pager_core and dat/quest.lua supply the offeredit text; js/questpgr.js already implements the pager and its nhlib.lua initialization draws.
nhlua.c:nhl_init loads dat/nhlib.lua before dat/quest.lua; the helper random calls at nhlib.lua:8 and shuffle at line 19 are downstream pager initialization, not the missing behavior owner.

The dothrow.c:thitmonst/js/dothrow.js caller path had overlapped the iron-ball delivery; that delivery is accepted at Main cfead60783b397097e20e05274512010fec57464 and the caller path is now available.

nethack-c/upstream/src/quest.c:finish_quest lines 226-279 chooses hasamulet, offeredit, or offeredit2 pager behavior, updates got_thanks and qcompleted, identifies returned objects, and refreshes inventory. quest.c:chat_with_leader lines 281-369 has two additional direct callers.
